Half Note smoky nuts and warm olives
the Half Note jazz club where Joe gets his chance

Almonds and cashews roasted with smoked paprika, honey and salt, served warm beside olives heated through with orange peel, garlic and rosemary. Toss 150g almonds and 150g cashews with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp sea salt. Roast on a lined tray at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once, and cool for 5 minutes so they crisp. Warm 250g mixed olives in a small pan with 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 strips orange peel, 2 smashed garlic cloves and a rosemary sprig for 5 minutes. Serve both in small bowls.

Joe's mum Libba and her tailor shop

Chicken roasted with lemon and thyme at 200C for 75 minutes, served with baked macaroni cheese and garlicky sautéed silverbeet. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and thyme, put a halved lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Cook 300g macaroni until just al dente. Melt 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, whisk in 600ml milk until thick and stir in 200g grated cheddar. Mix with the pasta, tip into a dish, top with 50g more cheddar and breadcrumbs and bake 20 minutes alongside the chicken. Sauté a bunch of silverbeet with garlic and oil to serve.
W: the maple seed that spins into Joe's hand
Butter, brown sugar and maple syrup creamed with an egg, flour and chopped pecans folded in, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
K: Joe's New York, the city 22 finally falls for

The old New York soda fountain classic of chocolate syrup and cold milk, hit with soda water and stirred hard until a thick white foam rises. Make a chocolate syrup by whisking 60g cocoa, 120g caster sugar and 125ml water over low heat for 3 minutes, then stir in a dash of vanilla and chill. Spoon 3 tbsp syrup into each of 4 tall glasses and add 120ml very cold full cream milk. Pour in 150ml cold soda water quickly while stirring hard with a long spoon until a thick foam rises to the top. Serve straight away.

s.note: 22 tasting a lollipop for the first time in Joe's body
s.how: Boil 200g sugar, 80ml glucose syrup and 80ml water to 150C without stirring. Take off the heat and stir in a drop of food colouring. Pour small rounds onto baking paper and press a lollipop stick into each. Leave to harden for 20 minutes.

s.note: 22 chatting with Dez in the barber's chair
s.how: Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with cream cheese and top each with a fold of smoked salmon, a few capers and thin slices of red onion. Lay them out on a tray, the kind of snack you eat in a barber's chair talking about life.

m.note: 22 tasting her first slice of New York pizza
m.how: Stretch 2 balls pizza dough (500g total) as thin as you can into big rounds. Spread with 200ml pizza sauce and 300g grated mozzarella. Bake on a very hot tray at 250C for 8 minutes until blistered, then dust with dried oregano and parmesan, cut into big slices and fold to eat.

w.note: the maple seed that spins into Joe's hand
w.how: Cream 125g butter with 100g brown sugar and 3 tbsp maple syrup, then beat in an egg. Fold in 200g flour and 80g chopped pecans. Roll into balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool on the tray and watch them spin down like seeds.
